text:
jess_procurement: NordicCompute reported an import license delay for FRA H100s. Options: airlift a small tranche now or split sea + air. They can offer a 20% A100 substitution at -15% list for short term. Need decision by EOD CET.
liam_sre: eu-west pools are tight (~7% headroom). If we don't airlift we'll need immediate routing changes and throttles. How big is the air uplift?
jess_procurement: Air uplift quoted +19% per unit, broker fee 100 EUR/unit. Sea only adds ~2-3wks delay, uplift +5%. Vendor can pre-assign AWBs if we confirm.
anya_logistics: FRA depot requires PO on AWB or they'll hold. If splitting shipments, we need separate AWBs and manifests. We can stage arrivals for RMA reconciliation but must have prepaid RMA labels to speed DOA processing.
sam_infra: A100 swap for up to 16 units likely raises p95 by ~10% on some models. We can route non-critical batches there and enable tighter batching on H100s. Ops-bot: gpu-queue alerts increased 2x in last hour.
liam_sre: Draft mitigation: accept 16 A100s to canary pool, airlift 10 H100s for critical traffic, sea remainder, reserve 24 depot slots for RMA staging.
jess_procurement: I'll push vendor to cap air uplift at +14% and waive broker fee if we accept phased sea. Also request prepaid RMA labels and immediate serial list for customs pre-clear. Decision needed today.
anya_logistics: Will prebook depot slots pending AWB+PO. Reminder manifest must include PO RW-2025-334.
sam_infra: Approved from infra. I'll prepare routing changes and flags.
liam_sre: +1. I'll update runbooks and monitoring dashboards.
ops-bot: deployment-bot: scheduled temporary throttles at 02:00 UTC and canary routing change at 03:00 UTC.
